description: This source file defines an enum 'GatewayPayloadDecoding' with static methods for decoding payloads conforming to the 'Decodable' protocol using JSON encoding and decoding. It provides utility functions to decode payloads into specific types, including handling optional payloads.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a payload of type 'AnyCodable' into a specified 'Decodable' type using JSON encoding and decoding.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Decodes a nullable payload into a specified 'Decodable' type if present, otherwise returns nil.
